lines: Seat 1 chooses Warden: at the end, 1 point per tile from your opening you still hold, beyond the first, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Shifting tile at (2, -1) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 chooses Hexer: at the end, 1 point per Scorch or Blight cast, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Shifting tile at (2, -1) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
A tie for the Shifting tile at (2, -1) (yields 3) at 3 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 3 wins the Steady tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2) for 1 mana.
Seat 1 gets the Wild tile at (2, -2) (yields 1) for free.
Seat 2 gets the Shifting tile at (2, -1) (yields 3) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (1, 1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 7 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.

If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.

Seat 2 wins the Wild tile at (0, 0) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Seat 1 wins the Steady tile at (0, 1) (yields 2) for 2 mana.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Seat 1's trait is Warden.
Seat 2's trait is Hexer.
Seat 3's trait is Wildheart.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 5 mana.
Seat 2 collects 5 mana.
Seat 3 collects 4 mana.
Attune the Shifting tile at (-1, 1) (yields 3) for 4 mana, leaving 4. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
Cast Blight for 3 mana: the Steady tile at (0, 1) (yields 2) yields nothing in the next round's income.
Attune the Steady tile at (1, -2) (yields 2) for 4 mana, leaving 7. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
All together: 7 mana, leaving 4.
Round 1.

Seat 2 attunes the Steady tile at (1, -2) (yields 2) for 4 mana.
